criteria.name: Major
criteria.description: Agent A makes a claim “c” to Agent B

criteria.name: Minor 1
criteria.description: Claim “c” uses a specific frame of interpretation “f” that alters interpretation of value “v”, action “α”, or state “s”

criteria.name: Minor 2
criteria.description: Frame “f” benefits A if B accepts the claim under this interpretation

criteria.name: Conclusion
criteria.description: Claim “c” should be scrutinised for manipulative framing

criteria.name: CQ1
criteria.description: What alternative frames could be applied to the same facts?

criteria.name: CQ2
criteria.description: How does frame “f” alter B's interpretation or likely actions?

criteria.name: CQ3
criteria.description: Does A have a record of using biased or self-serving frames of interpretation?

criteria.name: CQ4
criteria.description: What incentives does A have in using “f” rather than a neutral description?

criteria.name: CQ5
criteria.description: Would B act differently if “c” were framed otherwise?
